links.outcome: LLM preoperative risk classification accuracy versus expert consensus (ASA, NYHA, RCRI, pulmonary risk)
links.effect: ASA accuracy: DeepSeek 73.2%, Grok 70.7%, ChatGPT 58.5%. NYHA and RCRI: Grok 75.6%, ChatGPT 46.3%. Pulmonary risk: Grok 80.5%, DeepSeek 78.0%, ChatGPT 51.2%.
links.quote: This exploratory study reveals that current LLMs exhibit suboptimal concordance with expert consensus in preoperative planning for complex cardiac cases.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and agreement of three LLMs (ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Grok) on standardized clinical vignettes for preoperative anesthesia planning against an expert panel without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
